items.title: Bir kurstan bahsetmek
items.situation: A friend is thinking about the English course you are taking. Tell her about it.
items.situationTr: Bir arkadaşın gittiğin İngilizce kursunu düşünüyor. Ona kurstan bahset.
prompts: Say when and where the course is.
Say what you do in the lessons.
Say what you like about it.
Say one thing that is difficult.
promptsTr: Kursun ne zaman ve nerede olduğunu söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: It is twice a week, on Tuesday and Thursday evenings.
usefulPhrases.tr: Haftada iki kez, salı ve perşembe akşamları.

usefulPhrases.en: We speak a lot and we do very little grammar.
usefulPhrases.tr: Çok konuşuyoruz ve çok az dilbilgisi yapıyoruz.

usefulPhrases.en: The teacher is patient and she explains well.
The hardest part for me is listening.
usefulPhrases.tr: Benim için en zor kısım dinleme.

usefulPhrases.en: You should come and try one lesson.

items.title: Yol tarifi vermek
items.situation: A visitor stops you in the street. He is looking for the train station. Help him.
items.situationTr: Sokakta bir ziyaretçi seni durduruyor. Tren istasyonunu arıyor. Ona yardım et.
prompts: Tell him the way from here.
Say how long it takes on foot.
Mention something he will see on the way.
Tell him what to do if he gets lost.

usefulPhrases.en: Go straight on and take the second street on the left.
usefulPhrases.tr: Düz git ve soldaki ikinci sokağa sap.

usefulPhrases.en: It takes about ten minutes on foot.
You will pass a big hospital on your right.
usefulPhrases.tr: Sağında büyük bir hastanenin önünden geçeceksin.

usefulPhrases.en: If you get lost, ask again near the bridge.
You cannot miss it.

items.title: İşe hasta olduğunu bildirmek
items.situation: You woke up ill this morning. Call your manager and tell her.
items.situationTr: Bu sabah hasta uyandın. Müdürünü ara ve durumu bildir.
prompts: Say what is wrong.
Say that you cannot come in today.
Say what you will do about your work.
Say when you think you will be back.

usefulPhrases.en: I woke up with a high temperature.
I am afraid I cannot come in today.
I have sent the report to Ayla already.
I am going to the doctor this afternoon.
I hope to be back on Wednesday.

items.title: Bir şey ödünç istemek
items.situation: You need a suitcase for a short trip. Ask your neighbor if you can borrow hers.
items.situationTr: Kısa bir gezi için bavula ihtiyacın var. Komşuna onunkini ödünç alıp alamayacağını sor.
prompts: Ask for the suitcase politely.
Say why you need it.
Say when you will bring it back.
Thank her and offer something in return.
promptsTr: Teşekkür et ve karşılığında bir şey öner.

usefulPhrases.en: Could I borrow your suitcase for a few days?
usefulPhrases.tr: Birkaç günlüğüne bavulunu ödünç alabilir miyim?

usefulPhrases.en: I am going to Ankara on Friday.
I will bring it back on Monday evening.
Thank you, that is very kind of you.
Let me know if you need anything from there.

items.title: Taşındıktan üç ay sonra
items.situation: You moved to a new city three months ago. A friend asks how it is going.
items.situationTr: Üç ay önce yeni bir şehre taşındın. Bir arkadaşın nasıl gittiğini soruyor.
prompts: Say why you moved.
Say what is better than before.
Say what you miss.
Say how you are meeting people.
promptsTr: Öncekinden daha iyi olan şeyi söyle.

usefulPhrases.en: I moved here because of my job.
The buses are much better here.
I miss my family and my old neighbors.
I have met a few people at the gym.
It was hard at first, but it is better now.
usefulPhrases.tr: Başta zordu ama şimdi daha iyi.
